text:
Jamie (CEO): Heads-up: all-hands Friday 9:30am PT (40m). Agenda: exec priorities, short ops deep-dive, Dedicated launch checklist, security policy note, 15m open Q&A. Drop 1-2 Qs here or use the form: https://tiny.redwood/ah-q.

Nora (People Ops): Invite sent. Reminder set for 9:15am. Hybrid room + dial-in in the invite.

Rina (CPO): Ops deep-dive will cover autoscaling improvements and a customer case study on latency-sensitive routing. Planning 6 slides + demo gif.

Liam (Eng-Platform): FYI: autoscaler change needs a migration step for older Dedicated fleets. We'll show the migration checklist. Please flag any fleet owners.

Jess (Security): Quick notice: policy tweak around access logs retention for Dedicated customers. We'll present the summary and link to the draft policy for feedback.

ops-bot: Event created by Nora 0: "All-Hands — Q2 Ops + Launch" Friday 9:30am PT.

Jamie (CEO): Please send questions by Thursday 6pm. We'll answer top live and follow up on the rest.

Jamie (CEO) [post-call]: Recording: https://recordings.redwood.com/ah-1746000000. Key takeaways:
- Priorities: reliability SLAs, reduce tail latency, simplify Dedicated onboarding.
- Ops: autoscaler reduces cold-starts on burst traffic; migration checklist published (link below).
- Dedicated: new onboarding checklist shortens setup time; migration window scheduled next month.
- Security: retention defaults to 90 days; requests for >90d require KMS and approval.
- Actions: Eng-Platform to open migration RFC; Security to finalize policy draft; People Ops to circulate slides and recording.

Liam (Eng-Platform): Migration RFC now open: https://git.redwood/rfcs/614. Assigning reviewers.

Jess (Security): Draft policy: https://internal.redwood/policies/dedicated-logs. Feedback welcome by EOW.

Nora (People Ops): Slides + notes pinned in #all-hands and in the digest. Thanks team!
